name: Gluta White Day & Night Cream | Whitening Anti-Aging Hydrating 50g Face Care
description:
The Gluta White Day & Night Cream is a dual-action skincare solution that brightens, hydrates, and protects your skin around the clock. Enriched with glutathione, vitamin C, and collagen, it helps reduce dullness, fade dark spots, and soften fine lines. Its lightweight, non-greasy formula absorbs quickly, leaving your skin radiant, youthful, and moisturized all day and night.
Key Features
 Brightens skin and evens tone
 Reduces dark spots and pigmentation
 Hydrates deeply for soft, supple skin
 Anti-aging formula minimizes fine lines
 Lightweight, non-greasy quick-absorbing texture
 Suitable for all skin types, paraben-free
Ingredients / Materials
Glutathione, Vitamin C, Collagen, Hydrating Actives, Skin-Nourishing Extracts
How to Use
 Apply a small amount to cleansed face and neck
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use daily in the morning and at night
Package Includes
 1 × Gluta White Day & Night Cream (50g)
